symptom: No command showed the project id (the Projects$Project root unit $ID, which Business Events uses as the app id), so two apps made from one copied .mpr could only be found to share it by grepping mprcontents
cause: `describe settings` / `show settings` never read it, and the model-engine backend's GetProjectRootID was the generated `unimplemented` stub (only CreateModule reached the reader's method directly), so nothing on the backend interface could return it
file: mdl/backend/modelsdk/backend.go (GetProjectRootID); mdl/executor/cmd_settings.go (projectID, a `-- Project ID:` comment in describeSettings, a `Project` row in listSettings)
insight: A generated `unimplemented` stub on the backend hides a capability the reader already has: the interface looks complete and the call errors only at runtime, so check the stub list before concluding a value is unreadable. Describe output must stay executable, so a value with no `alter` spelling goes in a comment. The id read back matches the Projects$Project .mxunit file name in the fixture (bf10dffa-… on expr-checker), and the backend test pins it as every module unit's ContainerID. Not done: re-ID on copy / `mxcli new` (maintainer decision: read-only)
